## Counterfactual hospital vs no hospital

```{r, eval=FALSE}
## total infections, run to fade-out, for one set of conditions
total_infections <- function(beta_C, kappa, p_a, p_i, s_C0, s_H0, seed,
                             los, adm, threshold = 1, ...) {
  stopifnot(seed > threshold)   # otherwise the run stops at once
  
  N_H   <- adm * los
  N_C   <- N - N_H
  xi    <- s_H0 * (1 - s_C0) / (s_C0 * (1 - s_H0))
  alpha <- adm / N_C / (1 + s_C0 * (xi - 1))
  
  y0 <- c(S_C = s_C0 * N_C - seed, E_C = seed, I_C_pre = 0, I_C_post = 0,
          R_C = (1 - s_C0) * N_C,
          S_H = s_H0 * N_H, E_H = 0, I_H_pre = 0, I_H_post = 0, Q = 0,
          R_H = (1 - s_H0) * N_H,
          cum_onset_C = 0, cum_onset_H = 0, cum_noso = 0,
          cum_adm_rash = 0, cum_inf_C = 0)[state_names]
  
  p <- c(beta_C = beta_C, beta_H = kappa * beta_C,
         xi_alpha = xi * alpha, alpha = alpha, p_a = p_a, p_i = p_i,
         delta = 1 / los, delta_M = delta_M,
         sigma = sigma, eta = eta, gamma = gamma)
  
  sol <- ode(y0, 0:max_days, measles_ode, p, method = "lsoda",
             rootfunc = make_stop_condition(threshold),
             atol = 1e-3, rtol = 1e-6)
  last <- function(x) unname(sol[nrow(sol), x])   # value at the stop time
  
  tibble(total = last("cum_inf_C") + last("cum_noso"),   # infections after the start
         noso  = last("cum_noso"),
         faded = last("time") < max_days)
}

## total infections for every row of a scenario table (keeps the input columns)
run_all <- function(scen) bind_cols(scen, pmap(scen, total_infections) |> list_rbind())

## the same population without the hospital: no admissions and no transmission
## inside. Children with rash stay in the community and transmit like other
## children with rash, as the model assumes for children who are not admitted.
## The children who would have been inpatients live in the community, so
## community immunity becomes the population average (this uses the original
## adm, so keep it first).
no_hospital <- function(scen) {
  scen |>
    mutate(s_C0  = (s_C0 * (N - adm * los) + s_H0 * adm * los) / N,
           kappa = 0,
           p_a   = 0,
           adm   = 0)   # no admissions, so N_H = adm * los = 0: no hospital
}

## saved runs: rerun the block above after any change to the fit or the fixed values
net_B <- readRDS("net_B.rds")

## =============================================================================
## Figure (fast: reload with readRDS() to redraw without rerunning)
## =============================================================================
gsea6 <- pal_gsea("default", n = 6)(6)

brk_net <- c(-100, -50, -20, 0, 20, 50, Inf)
lab_net <- c("-100 to -50%", "-50 to -20%", "-20 to 0%",
             "0 to 20%", "20 to 50%", "more than 50%")

## one heatmap design for both panels: length of stay by kappa, one panel per
## combination of the row variable and p_i
net_heatmap <- function(data, facets, labeller, fitted_pt) {
  ggplot(data, aes(los, kappa)) +
    geom_contour_filled(aes(z = net_pct), breaks = brk_net, show.legend = TRUE) +
    geom_contour(aes(z = net_pct), breaks = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = kappa_ci, colour = "grey30", linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = fitted_pt, shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = "black",
               size = 2.2, stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = gsea6, labels = lab_net, drop = FALSE,
                      name = "Change in total infections with the hospital") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(4, 8, 12), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0", "0.5", "1"),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    facet_grid(facets, labeller = labeller) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE, title.position = "top")) +
    labs(x = "Mean length of stay (days)", y = expression(kappa)) +
    theme_plain +
    theme(panel.spacing = unit(3, "mm"),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
          axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.text = element_text(hjust = 0))
}

## A: the fitted hospital sits in the panel with the fitted s_H0 and p_i
fig_A <- net_heatmap(
  net_A, s_H0 ~ p_i,
  label_bquote(rows = s[H0] == .(round(s_H0, 2)), cols = p[i] == .(p_i)),
  tibble(los = 1 / delta, kappa = base$kappa, s_H0 = base$s_H0, p_i = p_i_fixed)
)

## B: the fitted hospital appears in every row of its p_i column
fig_B <- net_heatmap(
  net_B, s_comm ~ p_i,
  label_bquote(rows = list(s[C0] == .(s_comm), s[H0] == .(round(s_H0_from(s_comm), 2))),
               cols = p[i] == .(p_i)),
  tibble(los = 1 / delta, kappa = base$kappa, p_i = p_i_fixed)
)

fig_amp <- fig_A / fig_B +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))

fig_amp

# ggsave("figs/chap3/amplifier.png", fig_amp, width = 5, height = 8,
#        dpi = 300, bg = "white")


## ---- 1. the fitted hospital, over posterior draws (panel A) --------------------
post_net |>
  summarise(net_med     = median(net_pct),
            net_lo      = quantile(net_pct, 0.025),
            net_hi      = quantile(net_pct, 0.975),
            p_amplifier = mean(net_pct > 0))

## ---- 2. kappa above which the hospital amplifies (the black line) ---------------
## linear interpolation between the last kappa below 0% and the first at or above;
## NA means the hospital does not amplify for any kappa up to 1
kappa_amp <- function(kappa, net) {
  i <- which(net >= 0)[1]
  if (is.na(i)) return(NA_real_)
  if (i == 1) return(kappa[1])
  kappa[i - 1] + (0 - net[i - 1]) * (kappa[i] - kappa[i - 1]) / (net[i] - net[i - 1])
}

thr_A <- net_A |>
  arrange(s_H0, p_i, los, kappa) |>
  group_by(s_H0 = round(s_H0, 2), p_i, los) |>
  summarise(kappa_amp = kappa_amp(kappa, net_pct), .groups = "drop")

thr_B <- net_B |>
  arrange(s_comm, p_i, los, kappa) |>
  group_by(s_C0 = s_comm, p_i, los) |>
  summarise(kappa_amp = kappa_amp(kappa, net_pct), .groups = "drop")

## thresholds at mean stays of 2, 5 and 14 days (columns los_2, los_5, los_14)
thr_A |>
  filter(los %in% c(2, 5, 14)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = los, values_from = kappa_amp, names_prefix = "los_") |>
  print(n = Inf)

thr_B |>
  filter(los %in% c(2, 5, 14)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = los, values_from = kappa_amp, names_prefix = "los_") |>
  print(n = Inf)

## ---- 3. panel A: the change when s_H0 = 0.1 ----------------------------------------
net_A |>
  filter(near(s_H0, 0.1)) |>
  summarise(min = min(net_pct), max = max(net_pct))

## ---- 4. panel B: the absolute numbers behind the percentages --------------------
net_B |>
  filter(los == 5, near(kappa, 0.3) | near(kappa, 0.5) | near(kappa, 0.7),
         p_i %in% c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5)) |>
  select(s_C0 = s_comm, p_i, kappa, with_hospital = total,
         no_hospital = total_none, net_pct) |>
  arrange(s_C0, p_i, kappa) |>
  print(n = Inf)

## ---- 5. panel B: the fitted hospital (white points), at the fitted stay ---------
fitted_B <- imports |>
  mutate(kappa = base$kappa, p_i = p_i_fixed, los = 1 / delta) |>
  run_all() |>
  select(s_C0 = s_comm, with_hospital = total) |>
  left_join(imports |>
              mutate(p_i = p_i_fixed, los = 1 / delta) |>
              no_hospital() |>
              run_all() |>
              select(s_C0 = s_comm, no_hospital = total),
            by = "s_C0") |>
  mutate(net_pct = 100 * (with_hospital / no_hospital - 1))
fitted_B
```

## Relationship between $s_H$ and $s_C$

```{r}
df_plot <- expand_grid(s_C = seq(0, 0.15, by = 0.001), xi = 1:8) |>
  mutate(ratio = xi / (1 + s_C * (xi - 1)))

ggplot(df_plot, aes(s_C, ratio, colour = factor(xi))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85, direction = -1,
                         guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = seq(0, 0.15, 0.05),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:8, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.03))) +
  labs(x = expression("Community susceptible proportion," ~ italic(s)[C]),
       y = expression("Ratio," ~ italic(s)[H] / italic(s)[C]),
       colour = expression(xi)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

ggsave("figs/chap3/sc_sh.png", width = 4, height = 3, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
